scope: Surface-velocity consistency repair only. No certification of local rounded-tip/trailing-edge Cp, strip cm or sharp-wake side-edge pressures.

provenance.integration_change: Only solver version changed after the reviewed candidate; numerical source port 06 records the implementation.

method_change: Unfold adjacent centroids about shared panel edges before Lagrange surface differentiation.
Retain oblique surface-grid directions and metric.
Continue the final rounded-tip stencil across its closed shared seam.

unchanged: Raw Cp values and all tip samples
Admission criteria and old independent finer-reference data

admission.failed_checks: Only old base-mesh resultant identity pins for course4, dihedral6 and swept25. Recomputed force, bending and torque error/uncertainty checks pass against the unchanged old independent finer references.

twist.failed_check: Literal old expected uncertainty 1.950 +/- 0.955 N mm changed to 1.948 +/- 0.924 N mm. Unresolved classification and withheld twist are unchanged. All physical coverage and admission-state checks pass.

additional_original_criteria.test_method: Non-throwing diagnostic copies evaluate the remaining original assertions without changing inequalities or independent reference data. These are not labelled as passing unmodified suites. Original identity pins are preserved.

manufactured_tip_crossflow.exact_field: Harmonic square-root crossflow potential with branch point inside the closed tip, differentiated analytically and projected onto each panel tangent.

tradeoffs: Both reconstructions retain second-order convergence on the tested smooth non-lifting bodies. Some error constants increase by up to 30%; the original absolute benchmark checks pass.
Exact lifting conformal-section tests improve; a very thin NACA0001 coarse-grid pressure/wake lift mismatch is much smaller. These checks do not imply resolved corner Cp.

remaining_tip_issue.observation: Fixed-distance off-body perturbation velocity grows toward the tip/trailing-edge corner and the downstream wake side edge, consistent with a sharp-edge singularity of this idealised model. Mid-chord tip crossflow is bounded.
remaining_tip_issue.derivative_check: Fourth-order finite-difference step refinement from 0.002 to 0.00025 mm at eight fixed points changes normalised velocity by at most 3.51e-7. This uses the same BEM potential, so is a consistency diagnostic, not an independent physical reference.
remaining_tip_issue.pressure_status: Surface Cp on the last rows near the trailing edge remains quantitatively unvalidated; finer meshes can increase its extrema.
remaining_tip_issue.display: Amber/dashed local tip flags and raw values are retained. No clipping, fitted correction, smoothing or deletion.

external_comparisons.pyapm: An independent pyapm 0.0.4 full-thickness implementation on the same surface also shows a local tip upturn. Its negative pressure drag on this mesh prevents using its local Cp as ground truth. Qualitative corroboration only.
external_comparisons.AirFrame: The supplied archive contains executable/binary interfaces rather than full numerical implementation; no direct equality of equations or accuracy is claimed.
